name: agent-eval-evaluator
description: Designs, runs, scores, and reports evidence-based capability evaluations for AI agents.

displayDescription.en: Designs test suites, audits execution traces, scores agent behavior, and turns repeated evaluations into evidence-based product decisions.
displayDescription.zh: 覆盖测试集设计、评分量表、任务执行链审计与多轮汇总，量化智能体能力并输出可追溯的产品决策建议。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Generate a capability evaluation suite for my agent
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 为我的智能体生成一套能力评估用例

quickPrompts.en: Generate a capability evaluation suite for my agent
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的智能体生成一套能力评估用例

quickPrompts.en: Run this agent task and record an execution trace
quickPrompts.zh: 执行这个智能体任务并记录任务执行链

quickPrompts.en: Aggregate these evaluation JSON results into a product decision report
quickPrompts.zh: 汇总这些评分 JSON，生成产品决策评估报告
